blocks.text: The module documentation explains the two protected routing decisions, why they default to observe, the supported modes, and the clipped input budgets.
blocks.title: Fail-open routing policy

blocks.text: Gate modes accept on, observe, and off; unknown values become off. Counter helpers make TTL-backed increments and reads non-fatal.
blocks.title: Modes and counters

blocks.text: Panel constants define the eligible tier range, short path question, counter names, and the safe default verdict shape.
blocks.title: Panel gate setup

blocks.text: panel_verdict asks Laya for the probability that a task is more complex than its draft, while note_panel_skipped, record_panel_outcome, and get_panel_gate_stats track skip behavior and tier-raising outcomes.
blocks.title: Panel verdict and scoring

blocks.text: The second gate is restricted to expert/beast continuation decisions and treats only a confident STOP as a possible LLM-call skip.

blocks.text: gatekeeper_verdict sends compact structural state to Laya, and the remaining functions record whether the LLM agreed with STOP/CONTINUE and calculate stop precision.

gotchas: Panel pre-gating only considers tiers 0 and 1.
Gatekeeper pre-gating can only skip toward STOP.
purpose: This module asks Laya whether a routing decision looks safe to skip, while defaulting to observation so the existing panel or gatekeeper remains authoritative. It clips inputs, records counters with a TTL, and exposes precision statistics for deciding whether either gate can be enabled.
summary: Adds fail-open Laya pre-gates and outcome counters for panel and macro-loop decisions.

symbols.summary: Normalizes a gate mode and turns unknown values into a logged off state.
Increments a TTL-backed routing counter without letting storage errors escape.
Reads a counter as an integer and returns zero if storage or conversion fails.
Estimates whether the panel can be skipped for an eligible low-tier draft.
Updates panel-gate agreement counters using the actual panel tier decision.
Returns panel counters plus the fraction of harmless Laya skip recommendations.
Estimates whether a completed macro-loop pass is finished enough to skip the gatekeeper LLM.
Compares Laya's STOP recommendation with the actual LLM gatekeeper action.
Returns gatekeeper counters plus the precision of Laya STOP recommendations.
